# §6 Portal Engagement — Highlight Candidates

1. **Portal traffic climbed 46% from Q4 2025 to Q1 2026** — Daily visitors averaged 21.9 in Q1 2026 (Jan–Mar), up from 15.0 in Q4 2025 (Oct–Dec), with April 2026 month-to-date tracking at 27.3 — the highest monthly rate in the window. [→ §portal]
2. **Sessions average nearly 8 minutes** — Trailing 6-month average session duration of 7:51 (Oct 2025 – Mar 2026) indicates substantive catalog browsing rather than brief check-ins. [→ §portal]
3. **California, Texas, and Florida lead portal traffic** — The top three U.S. states account for 1,012 of 3,010 visitors (34%) over the trailing 6 months, with U.S. traffic comprising 95% of the total across 18 states. [→ §portal]
4. **Direct traffic dominates at 63%, referral links contribute 34%** — Most visitors arrive directly (bookmarks or typed URL) over the trailing 6 months, while a meaningful referral link share suggests inbound traffic from partner or company websites. [→ §portal]

## Priority Action Candidate
- **LOW**: Investigate the source of referral link traffic (1,422 visitors, 34% of total over the trailing 6 months) — understanding which external sites drive visitors could reveal partnership or SEO amplification opportunities. [→ §portal]
